headline: CoreWeave beats and raises, stock jumps ~16% premarket; Petrobras pumps a record but profit misses; CGI's penny beat; Franco-Nevada and Corteva tonight
top_call: CoreWeave grew revenue 168% to $3.66 billion vs $3.55 billion expected, lost less than feared on an adjusted basis (−$0.95 vs −$1.16) and raised its 2026 outlook, and the stock is up about 16% before the bell. Petrobras' adjusted EPS edged past at $1.44 but headline profit missed LSEG, Rigetti's tiny quarter missed, and CGI beat by a penny. Plain-English explainers below, plus Franco-Nevada and Corteva tonight.
subject: The Daily Five — Wed Nov 11: CoreWeave beats, raises, jumps 16% premarket
backdrop: Tuesday the S&P 500 slipped 0.38% and the Nasdaq 0.74% on hotter-than-expected inflation data and Nvidia's slide. This morning futures are higher (Nasdaq-100 about +1.6% at 4:30 AM ET) as CoreWeave lifts the neoclouds; the bond market is closed for Veterans Day, stocks are open.
on_deck_sub: Reporting after the close today, Nov 11, with Wall Street's EPS estimates per Yahoo Finance

ai.headline: Anthropic is offering 825 million shares at $70-78 each and plans to price on Nov 18 and start trading Nov 19, sources told CNBC; retail platforms could get roughly 20% of the deal
ai.why: The biggest AI IPO on the calendar now has a date. Its filing uses the word 'adverse' 257 times, which is either honesty or foreshadowing.

ai.headline: Nvidia is up about 3% premarket after its board hired law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate CEO Jensen Huang and whether company secrets were compromised
ai.why: The chip trade is bouncing with it (Broadcom, AMD, Intel higher). The headline risk hasn't gone anywhere.

ai.headline: Neoclouds rally behind CoreWeave: Nebius +10.2%, Applied Digital +6.4% and IREN +6.3% in early premarket trade
ai.why: One landlord said the tenants are still paying rent, so the whole street got repriced. Nebius reports tomorrow morning.
